Recheck every LIN year for the same substitution.

HIDE structural_not_presented (ruling 5): the band between Operating Profit and pretax holds only the interest line, and OI minus net interest equals pretax exactly. FY2017 Praxair 10-K (latest print for 2015) R2: "Operating Profit | 2,448 | 2,238 | 2,321"; "Interest expense – net | 161 | 190 | 161"; "Income Before Income Taxes and Equity Investments | 2,287 | 2,048 | 2,160" -> 2,321 - 161 = 2,160. Own FY2015 10-K R2 identical. "Other income (expenses) – net 28" (us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet) sits ABOVE Operating Profit and is operating, not non-operating.

Latest print for 2016 is Linde FY2018 10-K R2 (ASU 2017-07 recast): "Other income (expenses) – net | 18 | 4 | 23" (above OI, operating); "Operating Profit | 5,247 | 2,444 | 2,247"; "Interest expense – net | 202 | 161 | 190"; "Net pension and OPEB cost (benefit), excluding service cost | (4) | (4) | 9"; "Income From Continuing Operations Before Income Taxes and Equity Investments | 5,049 | 2,287 | 2,048" -> 2,247 - 190 - 9 = 2,048. The own FY2016 10-K (0000884905-17-000007) had only the interest line (2,238 - 190 = 2,048, ruling-5 HIDE), but one vintage serves the recast print, whose band now holds a non-interest non-operating line. The "conflict" is OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet (23, operating) vs the non-operating band.
rule_proposal: pension_nonservice_as_other_income: when the only non-interest line between OI and pretax is the non-service pension/OPEB cost, other_income_expense_net = minus that line (2016: -9,000,000), from the latest print; must match whatever LIN serves for 2017+ (2017: +4M from the same filing). Alternative: HIDE line_presented_combined if the pension line is ruled outside other_income. Needs the Standardization Lead perimeter call.
